# Dawson Gant

> Scottsdale-based operator, real estate investor, private pilot, competitive racer, and growth strategist.

## Summary

Dawson Gant is a 27-year-old operator based in Scottsdale, Arizona. He started in real estate at 18, has built or flipped more than 100 houses, scaled telehealth to seven figures in four months, leads a team of 50+ employees, holds a private pilot license, races competitively, and has donated seven figures to charity including Big Brothers Big Sisters Miami.

## Key Facts

- Name: Dawson Gant
- Age: 27
- Location: Scottsdale, Arizona, USA
- Education: North Carolina A&T State University (attended, left to build full-time)
- Real estate: 100+ houses built or flipped since age 18
- Telehealth: Built a brand to seven figures in four months
- Team size: 50+ employees across operations
- Aviation: Licensed private pilot
- Racing: Competitive race car driver
- Philanthropy: Seven figures donated; supports Big Brothers Big Sisters Miami
- Philosophy: Operator, not advisor — builds systems that compound
